name: Mohammed H. Alomairy
bio: Mohammed H. Alomairy, Ph.D, President of Innowex, Innovation with Excellence, a technology and consulting firm based in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. Dr. Alomairy has a PhD in Industrial engineering and MBA in Business administration from University of Central Florida, and BSc in electrical engineering from KAU in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. Dr. Alomairy has more than 20 years’ experience in Information Technology, Banking, Airlines and management consulting. He is Baldrige/EFQM/KAQA examiner and consultant. He is a certified PMP and LSSBB, He served as a Judge for the ASQ International Team Excellence Award and PAR Innovation award. Dr Alomairy is an executive board member of the Saudi Quality Council.
